brief: Research reactivation for previous buyers who have not purchased for7 days. Only Oak & Ink and Corner Supply may participate. A campaign can last up to14 days, spend at most$50 of simulated joint funding, and offer no more than5% off. Optimize mature retained PayPal contribution, not redemptions. Inspect the data, fit and test a candidate before committing or observing.
